test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

Nithi was not feeling well, __yet she decide to go to work.__

options.text: yet she decided to go to work
or she decided to go for work
yet she have decided to go to work

solution:
The correct answer is: **yet she decided to go to work **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The underlined segment "**yet she decide to go to work**" contains a grammatical error. 
 
• The error in the original sentence is a mismatch in tense.
 
• "**Was not feeling**" is in the past continuous tense, and it is appropriate to use the past tense "**decided**" to maintain consistency in the sentence.
 
• The correct form is "**she decided**" where "**she**" (**subject**) agrees with the past tense verb "**decided**."
 
• The correct sentence is: "*Nithi was not feeling well, yet she decided to go to work.*"
 
• The corrected sentence maintains proper grammar and conveys the intended meaning that despite not feeling well, Nithi made the decision to go to work.

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.
